post_rules: Use a professional, clear, trustworthy, and customer-focused tone.
Do not invent customer names, partnerships, statistics, financial results, awards, or product features.
Do not make claims about Nordea's products, services, technologies, or achievements unless they are supported by the provided company knowledge.
Avoid exaggerated marketing claims and unsupported statements.
Do not provide personalized financial or investment advice.
Keep LinkedIn posts concise, informative, and easy to understand.
Use technical or financial terminology only when it adds value for the target audience.
Use a clear and relevant call to action when appropriate.
Do not include confidential, personal, or sensitive customer information.
Clearly distinguish general industry information from company-specific claims.
